title: Tech Support LIVE | NETGEAR @ Home
description: Click here to access NETGEAR support articles: https://www.netgear.com/support/  Spend your time working from home, not working on your network. Jump in the chat for our weekly Tech Support LIVE stream series at Friday 4/10 at 12 PM PT and let us know how we can help out. You'll have direct access to our support team to help guide you on our live virtual hotline.  Need help setting up your router? Want some advice to help optimize your work-from-home network? Tell us your situation, the NETGEAR products you're using, and we'll get you set up to #StayConnected.  To contact NETGEAR Support and submit a Help ticket, please do the following: 1) Open a web browser and go to my.netgear.com 2) If you do not have an account, please create an account, otherwise log in with your existing account 3) Select "My Support," then click on "Contact Support" 4) Select "Get Help" on your NETGEAR product 5) Select the product you own from the dropdown list.  If you have not registered your product, select the link below the product selection box to register. 6) Once the product is selected, click the "Next" button. 7) Now you can select to contact Support through Email, Phone, or Online chat.  Be sure to subscribe for more videos! http://bit.ly/1JsK6Ej
